title: Pokemon TCG Morpeko 121/182 Holo Rare Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Reverse Holo Morpeko card is a must-have for any serious collector of Pokémon TCG cards. With its Holo Rare rarity and Paradox Rift design, this card is sure to be a standout addition to your collection. The card features Morpeko, a popular Pokémon character, and has the card number 121/182. 

The card's finish is Reverse Holo, which adds a unique touch to the card's overall design. This card falls under the Toys & Hobbies and Collectible Card Games categories and is a great addition to any CCG Individual Cards collection. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this rare and sought-after card to your collection.
